name: range
code:
import random
random.seed(7)
for i in range(20):
    x = random.random()
    if not (0.0 <= x < 1.0):
        print('bad')
print('ok')

name: randint
code:
import random
random.seed(3)
for i in range(30):
    v = random.randint(1, 6)
    if v < 1 or v > 6:
        print('bad', v)
print('ok')

name: randrange
code:
import random
random.seed(5)
print(random.randrange(10) >= 0 and random.randrange(10) < 10)
print(random.randrange(2, 10, 2) % 2)

name: choice
code:

print(x in xs)

name: sample
code:
import random
random.seed(11)

print(len(s))
print(len(set(s)))

name: choices
code:
import random
random.seed(13)

name: uniform
code:
import random
random.seed(17)
for i in range(10):
    u = random.uniform(2.0, 3.0)
    if u < 2.0 or u > 3.0:
        print('bad')
print('ok')
